program.name: Circuit and AMRAP
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: A bodyweight strength circuit, then an AMRAP to empty the tank.
program.about: Build, then empty the tank. Each day starts with a circuit of four bodyweight strength moves, round after round with a short rest, and ends with an AMRAP of three more, as many rounds as you can. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
program.split: A circuit, then an AMRAP, A / B, no gear
